# f45 (Fable's review): the lead A/B against f45-v. f45-v learns the lead (starts at 5 = 83 ms start to picture; its `[f45] lead 5 -> 4` line, if any, and `room: N of M judged` say whether the console has a refresh to spare); this run fixes 4 (67 ms). Compare `late`, `pattern slips` and `[lat]` pad->shown p50 between the two: if f45-l4 has no more late pictures than f45-v, 4 is safe at Vice and the learned lead should have found it. Pass rule: the log has `[f45] 45 cadence on` and `[f45] 300 pictures` lines (INVALID without). In live play: `off the pattern 0`; `[present]` held 1/2/3+ about 2 : 1 : 0; pattern slips under 8 % of the 45 pictures (late + held to a later predicted slot); interpolation error: pictures off their show vblank only behind slips (mean under 0.05 refreshes); no FALLBACK line at Vice; at most one fallback per match and never back and forth; `[speed]` 98 % or better; `[lat]` pad->shown p50 within 10 ms of the 30 FPS run (d30). Held scenes at 30 as in d30.
